name: Jamal
self_text: Hey there! I’m Jamal, in my early 30s and a proud Korean. I love getting lost in the world of Hollow Lantern most of the time, and I usually queue for casual matches when I have a chance. I play on a handheld platform, which makes it super convenient to jump into a game no matter where I am. I’m on the lookout for a coach—someone who can help me sharpen my skills and give me that extra edge. When I’m not gaming, I’m usually watching old westerns; there’s something about the dusty landscapes and classic storytelling that really keeps me hooked. I’m pretty relaxed and upbeat, always ready to dive into a good match or a great film. I’m usually free on Saturday afternoons or in the evenings during the week, so we can schedule a time that works for both of us. I enjoy meeting like-minded people who share a love for gaming and good conversation, and I’m always up for a chill chat over coffee after a session. I’d love to connect with someone who’s ready to play, learn, and have a bit of fun along the way!

requests.request_text: I need you to be into Hollow Lantern, otherwise we’re not compatible. I’d strongly prefer that you’re available either Saturday afternoon or weekday evenings, though I won’t rule you out over it. It would matter a lot if you’re the one who coaches me, but I won’t rule you out over it. Nice if we’re into casual matches, but no big deal.
